verdicts.reason: A: the dark panel takes up almost the whole canvas and bleeds off the left and bottom edges, so the night-city scene is lost except for an odd sliver down the right edge. The centred logo clashes with the left-aligned text, the 'OBSIDIAN ONE' eyebrow drops below the body copy, and the headphones and CTA float in empty space inside the panel. B: it keeps the starry city and has a deliberate headphone overlap on the panel. However, the logo sits awkwardly off-centre top-right, the eyebrow is again below the body copy, the centred CTA doesn't match the left-aligned copy, and the headline and body run almost to the panel edges with tight margins.
